folds.heading: ## UI-report reconciliation: actual receipts and remaining gaps (B249, 2026-11-04)
folds.body:
F1. Twelve complete UI report reads now supplement B247's checkpoints. R21b/c/R22/R22b/c have actual technical result reports, so their earlier saved-before-edit checkpoints no longer imply no result existed. This is attributed dated evidence, not current code/browser proof. Historical no-merge/no-push and released reservations remain scoped; none is reactivated. AD36/AD43 keep source, focused tests, whole-suite, frozen assets, rebuilt journey, native acquisition and persistence distinct. AD42 qualifies old human review as optional rather than the last mandatory authoritative gate.

F2. Preserve the meaningful technical failures and input windows. R3's final12 focused/affected desktop and save checks follow disclosed adjacent-source drift; the broader1786pass/twofail/threeTODO run predates final refinements. R12's one R11 hover failure was explicitly unresolved; R14's later clean interaction run does not establish its cause. R13's22-check result predates dedupe26; the runtime was refreshed in place without a separate frozen pre-dedupe build. R14's1773pass/zero fail clean export excludes unrelated dirty inputs and checks four selected served assets, not R3's entire565-source window. R15/R16 mixed suites retain baseline failures. A report's pass counts do not establish the untouched shared tree is clean.

F3. R16's500-row DOM clone probe measured only You/Focus and at most0.6ms for five forced measures; it is not500-item save/simulation performance proof. The M3 harness stopped after an obsolete inline-use locator despite earlier gather/craft/use, so the whole M3 journey is not closed there. Multiple real crafting-detail mounts justified scoped selectors rather than hiding a product failure. Focus tests now protect visible-focus-or-Attributes fallback instead of a stale zero-secondary-stat shape. Skills/Stances during a real fight and actual fight-to-idle return remain explicitly unshown in the relevant R16/R22c fixtures.

F4. Native recipe attempt count is not guaranteed output. R12's twelve chunks/six attempts include one failed spend and five successful receipt deltas; its known exact related uses stay within one station and base effect duration differs from bonus-adjusted detail. R18's real category CSS fix and same-row shown-value sorting control coexist with the documented one-row21px cost. Trade regional-price sort, stable-moment resort and item-key selection remain outside that claim. A favorite location is gameplay-save data; layout/category/seen choices are browser-local. A save/import check on one origin does not prove those local preferences travel with a gameplay export.

F5. R21c actually records6/6 awakening/home/reload/import checks and a one-time browser-spec migration after correcting a first layout that crushed the stat sheet. R22b later records H1–H6 passing and a separate dormant-export leak failure on its own candidate and base: exported strings exposed system-quests, Quest system and status-window. R22c retains the leak as open. Do not reuse R21c's older clean leak result on those changed inputs, infer the later culprit without evidence, or turn a dormant share/export defect into a claim every live UI leaked. Current actual selected disclosure/compatibility owners decide the affected route.

F6. R22's seeded event comparisons use multisets because same-tick order already varies on baseline; they do not prove byte-identical line ordering. Its custom palette is unit-checked but not live-browser verified; R22b later supplies a scoped light-palette check. R22c's selected by-kind display grouping retains named individual occurrences and current-wave links, qualifying the earlier strict per-opponent display limitation without merging histories or changing actual events. Its Usable-to-idle check toggled a fight flag manually, not a natural exit. Under AD32 old layout/skin/grouping options remain scoped choices, and current desktop14/21px/prose-first/optional-art direction governs selected changes. No new runtime, primary-source, install, commit or player acceptance was established.
